# Contributing / Contribuindo — Claude Skills Factory
<!-- Generated by generate-datasheet v4.1. Evidence-based — sources cited per section. -->

## Quick Start / Início Rápido
<!-- source: CLAUDE.md, README.md -->

```bash
# Clone the repo
git clone https://github.com/thiago-a11y/claude-skill-generate-datasheet.git
cd claude-skill-generate-datasheet

# Test CodeDocs (no install needed)
python3 -m codedocs . --no-browser

# Test a skill (requires Claude Code)
# Open Claude Code in the repo, type: /generate-datasheet
```

No dependencies. No build step. No package manager.

## Repo Structure / Estrutura
<!-- source: find . -type f -->

```
skills/{name}/SKILL.md   — Claude Code skill files (MIT)
codedocs/*.py             — Offline CLI tool (BSL)
docs/*.md                 — Research + generated docs
README.md                 — GitHub landing page
ROADMAP.md                — Vision + roadmap
CLAUDE.md                 — Repo context for AI tools
```

## Rules / Regras
<!-- source: CLAUDE.md:25-32 -->

### Skills
- Each skill = one SKILL.md file in `skills/{name}/`
- No executable code — skills are instruction files
- Every scan command must be real, runnable shell command
- Every template must include `<!-- source: {file}:{line} -->` comments
- Uncertainty markers ([VERIFY], [NOT DETECTED], [MANUAL]) must never be removed
- Keep language in English (README has PT-BR section)

### CodeDocs
- Zero external dependencies — only Python stdlib
- No network calls, no telemetry, no data egress
- All intelligence is rules-based (lookup tables, scoring formulas)
- Same input = same output (deterministic)
- BSL license — free internal use, commercial license for resale/hosting

### Versioning / Versionamento
<!-- source: CLAUDE.md:30-32 -->
- Version in SKILL.md frontmatter `version:` field
- Major version = new layer or major feature
- Minor version = improvement to existing layer
- Patch version = fix

## Adding a New Skill / Adicionando Nova Skill
<!-- source: CLAUDE.md:35-38 -->

1. Create `skills/{skill-name}/SKILL.md` with frontmatter
2. Add install instructions to README.md
3. Add to ROADMAP.md if planned
4. Update CLAUDE.md structure section and skills catalog

### Skill Frontmatter Template
```yaml
---
name: my-new-skill
version: 1.0.0
description: |
  What this skill does.
  Use when: "trigger phrases".
allowed-tools:
  - Bash
  - Read
  - Write
  - Edit
  - AskUserQuestion
---
```

## Adding CodeDocs Features / Adicionando Features no CodeDocs
<!-- source: codedocs/*.py -->

| File | What to edit | When |
|------|-------------|------|
| `scanner.py` | Add new `_scan_*` function + grep patterns | New detection capability |
| `migration.py` | Add to `TECH_EQUIVALENCES`, `PACKAGE_EQUIVALENCES`, `TARGET_PLATFORMS` | New migration mapping |
| `renderer.py` | Add/modify HTML template functions | New output format |
| `cli.py` | Add CLI flags/arguments | New user options |

## Commit Style / Estilo de Commit
<!-- source: git log --oneline -10 -->

```
v4.1: AI API Cost Audit in Layer 4 — description
CodeDocs v1.2: target selector + technology equivalences
refactor: multi-skill repo structure — description
add Reddit launch post + automated posting script (PRAW)
```

Pattern: `scope: short description` with Co-Authored-By trailer.
